bodies: Golf Course Superintendents Association of America

exams.name: ACSM Certified Clinical Exercise Physiologist
exams.blurb: Degree-required credential for exercise professionals delivering clinical exercise testing and rehabilitation for chronic disease.

exams.name: ACSM Certified Exercise Physiologist
exams.blurb: Degree-required credential covering fitness assessment, exercise prescription and programme design for apparently healthy clients.

exams.name: ACSM Certified Group Exercise Instructor
exams.blurb: Credential covering class design, cueing, music use, participant monitoring and safety for group exercise leaders.

exams.name: ACSM Certified Personal Trainer
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited personal training examination emphasising evidence-based assessment, programming and behaviour change.

exams.name: ACSM/ACS Certified Cancer Exercise Trainer
exams.blurb: Specialty credential for training cancer survivors, covering treatment side effects, assessment and safe programme design.

exams.name: ACSM/NCHPAD Certified Inclusive Fitness Trainer
exams.blurb: Specialty credential on adapting exercise programmes and equipment for clients with physical, sensory and cognitive disabilities.

exams.name: NASM Certified Nutrition Coach
exams.blurb: Certification covering nutrition science, dietary assessment and behaviour change coaching within the fitness professional scope.

exams.name: NASM Certified Personal Trainer
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited personal trainer examination organised around the Optimum Performance Training model of programme design.

exams.name: NASM Corrective Exercise Specialist
exams.blurb: Specialisation on movement assessment, muscle imbalance correction and integrated exercise strategies for compensations.

exams.name: NASM Group Personal Training Specialist
exams.blurb: Specialisation covering small-group programme design, space and equipment management, and coaching multiple clients at once.

exams.name: NASM Performance Enhancement Specialist
exams.blurb: Sport performance specialisation covering periodisation, power development, agility training and athlete testing protocols.

exams.name: NASM Weight Loss Specialist
exams.blurb: Specialisation combining exercise programming, nutrition guidance and behavioural coaching for clients pursuing fat loss.

exams.name: NSCA Certified Performance and Sport Scientist
exams.blurb: Credential for practitioners applying athlete monitoring, data analysis and research methods within performance programmes.

exams.name: NSCA Certified Personal Trainer
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited examination for trainers working with clients of all abilities, covering assessment, programming and safety.

exams.name: NSCA Certified Special Population Specialist
exams.blurb: Credential for training clients with chronic conditions, disabilities or age-related limitations under medical clearance.

exams.name: NSCA Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist
exams.blurb: Degree-required credential and two-part examination in scientific foundations plus practical and applied athlete programming.

exams.name: NSCA Tactical Strength and Conditioning Facilitator
exams.blurb: Credential for coaches training military, fire, police and other tactical personnel for occupational physical demands.

exams.name: ACE Certified Personal Trainer
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited personal trainer examination built around the ACE Integrated Fitness Training model and client rapport.

exams.name: ACE Group Fitness Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited examination covering class formats, choreography, cueing, participant screening and group safety practices.

exams.name: ACE Health Coach Certification
exams.blurb: Credential covering behaviour change coaching, nutrition guidance within scope, and lifestyle programming for chronic conditions.

exams.name: ACE Medical Exercise Specialist
exams.blurb: Advanced credential for trainers working with clients recovering from injury or managing chronic disease alongside clinicians.

exams.name: AMGA Alpine Guide Certification
exams.blurb: Multi-course examination track assessing glacier travel, snow and rock technique, rescue and client management in alpine terrain.

exams.name: AMGA Rock Guide Certification
exams.blurb: Assessment track covering multi-pitch rock guiding, anchor systems, short-roping, rescue and risk management in the field.

exams.name: AMGA Single Pitch Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: Entry climbing instructor credential assessed on top-rope site management, anchors, belaying and group supervision.

exams.name: AMGA Ski Guide Certification
exams.blurb: Assessment track for backcountry ski guiding covering avalanche hazard, route selection, skiing skill and rescue practice.

exams.name: CrossFit Level 1 Trainer Certificate
exams.blurb: Two-day course and examination covering CrossFit methodology, the nine foundational movements, scaling and class coaching.

exams.name: CrossFit Level 2 Trainer Certificate
exams.blurb: Course and examination focused on coaching development, movement correction, lesson planning and group management skills.

exams.name: CrossFit Level 3 Certified Trainer
exams.blurb: NCCA-accredited examination for experienced CrossFit coaches covering methodology, programming, nutrition and professional practice.

exams.name: CrossFit Level 4 Coach Certificate
exams.blurb: Highest CrossFit credential using a live performance-based evaluation of coaching, programming and athlete assessment.

exams.name: ISSA Certified Personal Trainer
exams.blurb: Open-book online personal trainer certification covering anatomy, programme design, nutrition basics and client assessment.

exams.name: ISSA Elite Trainer Certification
exams.blurb: Bundled credential combining personal training with two specialisations such as nutrition and strength and conditioning.

exams.name: ISSA Nutritionist Certification
exams.blurb: Certification covering macronutrients, dietary assessment, supplements and coaching clients within a non-clinical scope of practice.

exams.name: ISSA Strength and Conditioning Coach Certification
exams.blurb: Specialisation covering periodisation, Olympic lift progressions, speed development and athlete testing for sport performance.

exams.name: PADI Divemaster Certification
exams.blurb: First professional diving rating, assessed on dive theory examinations, watermanship, rescue skills and supervising divers.

exams.name: PADI Instructor Development Course
exams.blurb: Assistant instructor and open water scuba instructor programme preparing candidates for the PADI Instructor Examination.

exams.name: PADI Instructor Examination
exams.blurb: Independently conducted examination after the Instructor Development Course, testing theory, standards, teaching and rescue.

exams.name: PADI Open Water Diver Certification
exams.blurb: Entry recreational scuba certification with knowledge reviews, a final examination, confined water skills and four open water dives.

exams.name: Certified Golf Course Superintendent
exams.body: Golf Course Superintendents Association of America
exams.blurb: Credential requiring an examination and site attestation covering turf management, environmental stewardship and facility operations.
